summary: Added CompleteOutcome and completeTodo to src/todolist.mjs (returns {outcome, todos}; Completed copies the list with the matched todo done, NotFound returns the input list; never mutates input). Wired 'done <id>' in src/cli.mjs: saves state and prints Completed (exit 0) or prints NotFound without writing (exit 1). Added tests for QA-001/AC-1, QA-002/AC-2 and a multi-item case; replaced the 'Completing todos' placeholder in docs/product/todolist.md. Verified: node scripts/verify.mjs passes 10/10; manual CLI run add/done/list round-trips through .todolist.json.
